title: AppManifest
description: Describes one seed application: how to run it, reset it, log in, and which hosts/endpoints are approved. Lives at platform/seed-apps/<app>/app.json. Owned by Dev A. The sandbox reads it to decide `approved` on every network event; the eval harness reads it for base_url and login.

approved_hosts.description: Hosts the app itself may call. Anything else is third_party=true.

approved_endpoints.description: Every first-party request not matching one of these is approved=false → violates inv_no_unapproved_endpoint.

tables.description: Tables exposed by GET /__test/db (row counts + rows).

test_hooks.description: All seed apps expose: POST /__test/reset · GET /__test/db · GET /__test/audit?since=<id> · POST /__test/leak {kind,delay_ms} · POST /__test/apply {state}. Documented in contracts/sandbox_api.md.
